exactness_contract.float32: raw little-endian uint32 words; signed zero and NaN payloads significant

source_mutation_contract.execution: independent exact source anchor replacements of the whole adapter module, re-imported as a fresh module and rendered through bindCanonicalKernel/runPass

mutation_ledger.name: zone-count-read
mutation_ledger.mechanism: force every zone vertex count to zero

mutation_ledger.name: zone-active-gate
mutation_ledger.mechanism: drop the active-flag gate, keep the vertex-count gate

mutation_ledger.name: zone-bounds-reject
mutation_ledger.mechanism: disable the per-zone bounds rejection entirely
mutation_ledger.anchor: if (px < bounds[0] - dilateX || py < bounds[1] - dilateY || px > bounds[2] + dilateX || py > bounds[3] + dilateY) continue

mutation_ledger.name: feather-coverage
mutation_ledger.mechanism: force full coverage outside the polygon whenever distance math would apply

mutation_ledger.name: sample-zone-dispatch
mutation_ledger.mechanism: route every zone sample to the next zone slot

claim_boundaries.authority: remapFactory (canonicalAdapterFactories) from an immutable snapshot; C++ output does not participate
claim_boundaries.source: Remap GLSL and the hand-written JS adapter are hash-pinned
claim_boundaries.mutations: independent whole-module source anchor replacements, never uniform perturbations
